name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-connection
description: Dev-time type-only shim for the dsh-advisor plugin repo. The real package is private (not on the npm registry) and ships from the host dsh app at runtime; this stub provides the consumed wire types (IApiClient with the settings/llm domains, SettingsNamespaceView, SettingsPathOpView, ConnectionHandle, RpcRequest/RpcResponse/RpcResult minimal shapes). The client half imports these type-only; the wire value reaches the section via cordis injection (ctx.get('connection')). Mirrors dsh-private commit b8343cb (2026-08-09 snapshot).
